Eligible Product Categories

Where your 5% to 10% discount applies

Discounts are configured directly in our Odoo ERP pricelist rules, automatically deducting at checkout.

1. Consumables & Pantry

The everyday essentials that keep your café flowing:

  • Speciality Beans: Vreugde, Imani, Mi Amor, Gracia, Guatemala Natural, Swiss Water Decaf.
  • Compostable Pods: WOSC signature blend pods.
  • Milk Alternatives: Barista oat, almond, soy milks.
  • Packaging: Double-wall takeaway cups, lids, and compostable straws.
  • Barista Pantry: Gourmet syrups, artisanal hot chocolate, chai blends.
  • Hygiene & Maintenance: Espresso machine backflush detergent, milk line cleaner, grinder burr crystals.

2. Commercial & Barista Equipment

Capital investments where 5–10% yields immediate substantial savings:

  • Commercial Espresso Machines: Wega Rover 2-Group (Save up to R7,217).
  • On-Demand Grinders: Mythos Iris Grinders (Save up to R1,975).
  • Batch Brewers: Lebrew Brewmaster Thermo & decanters.
  • Water Systems: Flojet Bottled Water Dispensing Systems & BWT water filters.
  • Barista Smallwares: Precision scales, calibrated tampers, milk pitchers, knockboxes.
  • Spare Parts: Group gaskets, shower screens, steam tips.
Odoo ERP Architecture

How WOSC Automates the Membership Experience

Designed natively inside Odoo with zero third-party sync connectors, avoiding inventory discrepancies or billing delays.

STEP 01

Product Categories

Configured in Odoo Inventory as distinct categories: Consumables and Equipment.

STEP 02

Pricelists

Advanced Price Rules apply 5% discount (Retail Member) or 10% discount (Wholesale Member) strictly to eligible categories.

STEP 03

Odoo Subscriptions

Recurring monthly and annual subscription products automatically trigger membership status upon confirmed payment.

STEP 04

Automated Assignment

Odoo Automated Actions immediately update the partner's contact pricelist, making member discounts live in the portal & POS.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about the program

How do member discounts work when ordering online?

When you sign into your WOSC customer portal on our Odoo website, your Retail or Wholesale member pricelist is automatically active. All prices across our shop and machine catalog immediately display your discounted rate.

Can I switch from Monthly to Annual billing later?

Yes. You can switch to annual billing at any point from your customer account portal to take advantage of the ~17% annual discount (2 months free).

Are consulting or shopfitting services discounted?

Discounts apply strictly to Consumables and Equipment. Architectural design, turn-key shopfitting, and one-on-one custom consulting are priced separately per project scope.

What are the eligibility requirements for Wholesale?

Wholesale membership is open to registered businesses (CIPC registered) operating in hospitality, retail, food service, or offices with projected regular monthly coffee volume.
